title: botrychium × elegans
intro: Botrychium × elegans, commonly known as the "Fern-like Lady Fern" or "Fern-leaved Lady Fern," is a hybrid species of the genus Botrychium, which belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This rare and unique plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to support liver function, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Botrychium × elegans are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including isofuranones, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been found to contain other bioactive compounds, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic potential.
